component.name: ChatBridge
component.summary: Two-way chat history sync between Cursor and Claude

description.p: ChatBridge keeps your conversations in step between Cursor and Claude. Continue a task in either tool and carry it over to the other, with every message, the model's reasoning and all tool calls with their outputs.

ul.li: Import and sync in both directions, including conversations continued in both tools
Append-only and reversible: nothing is rewritten or deleted, and every write into Cursor can be undone
Optional auto-sync for conversations that are already paired
Supports several Cursor profiles and read-only backups

screenshot.caption: Conversations from both tools with their sync state
